summary: CSS object-fit for a RawImage: Contain letterboxes, Cover crops.
overview: Contain sizes the image to fit entirely within its parent, letterboxed and never cropped. Cover fills the parent entirely, cropped and never letterboxed — pair that with a Mask or RectMask2D on the parent to actually clip the overflow. It reads the assigned texture's own aspect, so it adapts when the texture changes.
useCases: Photo or thumbnail display where images vary in shape.
A full-bleed background that must not distort.
Video or streamed content of unknown aspect.

params.tuning: Cover without a mask on the parent overflows visibly. That pairing is not optional.

gotchas.title: Cover needs a mask to look right
gotchas.body: It deliberately sizes the image beyond the parent. Without clipping, the overflow just draws over its neighbours.
